The reference reverses the stated relation.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02944","case1_error":"Reports unsupported $100 after correct profit formulas implying $180; a later profit-per-mile expression also lacks necessary parentheses.","case2_error":"Miscounts people as 26 and treats 12 eggs per basket as 12 per person, inventing a 312-egg total.","reason":"Case 1 gives an unsupported result despite correct core formulas, with a later grouping error; case 2 misassigns quantities and constructs incorrect totals.","judgment":"different"}]}
